claimed_scope: Explicit successor semantic contract for the post-PR659 WP206 source/bookkeeping gap. Implement one versioned, deterministic, fail-closed migration path from accepted-G1 persisted legacy full-UnifiedDBFingerprint authority receipts to the current FRANKENSTEIN2_UNIFIEDDB_BOUND_FILE_AUTHORITY/v1 receipt used by the canonical reader. Migration must require exact externally supplied expected legacy receipt plus exact checkpoint digest, verify current canonical path/device/inode and typed checkpoint bytes before mutation, CAS-update only the exact row, preserve an append-only versioned migration receipt, and make the migrated row readable by the unchanged current reader. Wrong legacy receipt, wrong checkpoint digest, wrong DB identity, replayed/conflicting migration, or post-migration receipt tamper must fail closed. Do not silently auto-migrate ambiguous legacy rows. Same-inode live data/schema drift remains a separate discriminator and is explicitly out of scope. Repository source/tests/CI only; no target-host/VPS, physical GRID10, GWT/J-Space, provider/model, effect/completion, training or whole-system credit.
